body: [b]THE THREE STATS[/b]
[color=#00ff00]Ambition[/color] — scope. The Defining Game needs 25+.
[color=#ffff00]Instability[/color] — chaos. The target window depends on archetype.
[color=#ff7fff]Soul[/color] — conviction. Starts at 12. Dev Log +1. Fix Bugs costs 2.
[b]FOUR ACTIONS[/b]
Place Feature — adds the card's Ambition and Instability. Costs 1 day.
Fix Bugs — -10 Instability, -2 Ambition, -2 Soul. Costs 1 day.
Dev Log — +1 Soul. Costs 1 day.
Ship It — no day cost. Ends the run.
[b]THREE-RUN ARC[/b]
Run 1 is prospecting. Defining Game status is locked until Run 2.
Run 2 unlocks uncommon cards and the real target window.
Run 3 unlocks rare cards and resolves the full studio arc.
[b]ENDINGS[/b]  [i](checked in order at ship)[/i]
[color=#ff00ff]Defining Game[/color] — Ambition 25+, Instability in archetype window, Soul 7+.
[color=#ff8c42]Legendary Jank[/color] — 55+ Instability and a discovered jank combo.
[color=#74c0fc]Surprise Hit[/color] — Soul 8+, Ambition 15–24.
[color=#cc5de8]Prestige Collapse[/color] — Ambition 25+, Soul 4 or less.
Everything else becomes [color=#cccccc]Shipped Something[/color].
• 21 runway days total.
• Ship different card combos to unlock more.
• Archetype sets your Defining Game instability window and offer pool.
• Run 1 is about discovery. Wrong endings are expected.
• Jank discoveries can return as cards in later runs.
